topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute system commands via the deviceName POST parameter.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Oracle Solaris and Zettabyte File System (ZFS) Unspecified Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Oracle Solaris and Oracle ZFS Storage Appliance Kit contain an unspecified vulnerability causing high impacts to confidentiality, integrity, and availability of affected systems.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Reader and Acrobat Memory Corruption Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Adobe Reader and Acrobat contain a memory corruption vulnerability which can allow attackers to execute arbitrary code or cause a denial of service.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: WatchGuard Firebox and XTM Appliances Arbitrary Code Execution
topMovers.shortDescription: On WatchGuard Firebox and XTM appliances, an unauthenticated user can execute arbitrary code.

topMovers.product: ProCurve Manager (PCM), PCM+, Identity Driven Manager (IDM), and Application Lifecycle Management
topMovers.vulnerabilityName: HP Multiple Products Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: HP ProCurve Manager (PCM), PCM+, Identity Driven Manager (IDM), and Application Lifecycle Management allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a marshalled object to (1) EJBInvokerServlet or (2) JMXInvokerServlet.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Kaseya VSA Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Kaseya VSA RMM allows unprivileged remote attackers to execute PowerShell payloads on all managed devices.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall Secure Remote Access (SRA) SQL Injection Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: SonicWall Secure Remote Access (SRA) products contain an improper neutralization of a SQL Command leading to SQL injection.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Apache Struts 2 Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: The ExceptionDelegator component in Apache Struts 2 before 2.2.3.1 contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Flash Player Memory Corruption Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: A memory corruption vulnerability exists in Adobe Flash Player that allows an attacker to perform remote code execution.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Sonatype Nexus Repository Manager Incorrect Access Control Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Sonatype Nexus Repository Manager before 3.15.0 has an incorrect access control vulnerability. Exploitation allows for remote code execution.

highestSignals.product: Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management
highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Firewall Management Center Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management contain an authentication Bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and execute script files on an affected device to obtain root access to the underlying operating system.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: ConnectWise ScreenConnect Improper Privilege Management and Missing Authorization Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains both an improper privilege management and missing authorization vulnerability that may allow an attacker to transfer and execute files through an active remote session without authorization or host confirmation.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an authentication-bypass vulnerability involving an alternate path or channel. When the NetScaler appliance is configured as an AAA virtual server or as a Gateway (SSL VPN, ICA Proxy, CVPN, or RDP Proxy), an unauthenticated remote threat actor may be able to bypass authentication.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet Multiple Products Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS, FortiSwitchManager, and FortiSASE contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specially crafted packets.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Email Gateway SQL Injection Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Cisco AsyncOS software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway (SEG) contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: MikroTik RouterOS Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacker to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: MikroTik RouterOS Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: MikroTik RouterOS contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows kernel memory disclosure and denial of service in the btest service.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Out of Bounds Write Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 contains an out of bounds write vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.
Google Pixel devices contain an improper authorization vulnerability in the cellular modem. A logic error may allow an attacker to bypass permission checks and escalate privileges.
JFrog Artifactory contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that leads to a privilege escalation attack due to a validation check of the token signature/issuer and not the token’s scope.

observations: CISA added 12 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days.
Network Edge / VPN is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (5).
Cisco has the most new KEV entries this week (2).
CVE-2020-10987 is the largest 7-day rank riser, up 625 positions.
executiveSummary: CISA added 12 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days. Network Edge / VPN is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (5). Cisco has the most new KEV entries this week (2). CVE-2020-10987 is the largest 7-day rank riser, up 625 positions.
